questions.q: How does the Grouping pane relate to the design surface?
options: Selection is synchronized in both directions — selecting a group in the pane highlights the matching cell, and vice versa
The Grouping pane only shows information; it can never be used to select anything
They're completely unrelated features
The Grouping pane only works for Chart data regions
questions.explain: Selecting a group in the Grouping pane highlights the corresponding cell on the design surface, and selecting a grouping cell on the design surface highlights the matching entry in the pane.

questions.q: What's the difference between a child group and an adjacent group?
options: A child group is nested (indented) under its parent and repeats once per parent instance; an adjacent group is a sibling at the same depth representing a separate grouping
There is no difference — both terms describe identical behavior
An adjacent group must always be numeric
A child group can only exist in a Table, never a Matrix
questions.explain: Parent/child groups are indented under each other; adjacent groups sit at the same visual depth but are genuinely separate groupings, added via the Add Group shortcut rather than a plain drag.

questions.q: What does interactive sort let a report VIEWER do that design-time sort doesn't?
options: Click a column header button to re-sort detail rows on demand, without changing the report definition
Permanently edit the report's underlying dataset
Change the report's data source connection string
Interactive sort and design-time sort are the same feature with different names
questions.explain: Interactive sort adds a clickable header button that lets the viewer re-sort detail rows at runtime, separate from whatever fixed sort order was set at design time.

questions.q: How do you add interactive sorting to a column header?
options: Right-click the header text box, select Text Box Properties, then Interactive Sorting, and enable it with a chosen sort field
Interactive sorting is enabled automatically for every table by default
Only through SQL Server Management Studio, never Report Builder
By deleting the column's group and re-adding it
questions.explain: Right-click the text box, open Text Box Properties, go to Interactive Sorting, enable it on that text box, and specify a sort expression/field.

questions.q: What's Microsoft's specific guidance for dragging a field into the Grouping pane?
options: Avoid dragging the field across other report items on the design surface, since that selects those items and deselects your data region — drag down through the Report Data pane, then across into the Grouping pane instead
Always hold Shift while dragging to enable grouping
Fields can only be added to the Grouping pane by typing their names manually
Dragging fields into the Grouping pane is not supported; only Row/Column groups dialogs work
questions.explain: Dragging across other report items on the design surface accidentally selects them and deselects the intended data region — dragging straight down the Report Data pane and across into the Grouping pane avoids that.
